author: browser_acceptance
resolved_findings: Corrected quality form label selectors against actual ERP_ACTIONS.
CSV parser uses semicolon and compares IDs, currencies, and values.
Readiness explicitly awaits loading indicator disappearance.
Harness requires clean exact checkout, intended repository/push/feature branch and first runner attempt; evidence outside source under RUNNER_TEMP.
Coverage omissions and synthetic legacy-BLOB denial fixture are explicit.
scope: Real UI auth, groups, filters, map, CSV, reference converter, transfers/quality, holds/payments, mobile layout, role/API denials are represented by actual browser operations and server responses.
Random synthetic users and fresh SQLite/media; data cleanup, source digest and source database canaries; Chrome preinstalled only, no browser-download fallback.
Screenshot and HTTP/console artifacts are captured; screenshot review remains pending after actual CI.
remaining_limits: Top-level scope-job workflow integration independently reviewed by integration_diagnosis.
Static harness acceptance does not prove selectors/DOM behavior or application acceptance without actual CI execution.

Browser scope excludes live permission-revocation race, typed stale UI recovery, lost confirm-response injection, RFQ/quote/purchase UI creation, converter reload, JSON equivalence, full accessibility/Windows/historical gates.
